reviews.comment: Megan taught my yoga class this semester, and she is great! She has a wonderful personality and connects with her students on a personal level. She makes her class criteria very clear, and even though she is strict on the assignments in her class, she makes it easy to obtain an A.

Beginners yoga must be taken with her! She is so fun and makes roll call interesting. I would look forward to her class because it was time that I had to dedicate to myself. There was an easy group project and skills test. She also did some journals about your life and how your yoga journey was coming along.

Megan is literally so sweet. I took her for KINE 199 (beginner's yoga) and she did not disappoint. Attendance is mandatory, there's one group project (really simple), and a couple skills test. She's such a great instructor and the class really benefitted my mental health! If you're even thinking about taking it, take it with her!
